arguments.description: Check ledger size and fix apostrophe typos
arguments.command: cd D:\lean; $p=(Get-Item AUDIT_LEDGER.md); Write-Host SIZE=$($p.Length); $bytes=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p.FullName); Write-Host FIRST_BYTES=$($bytes[0..3] -join ','); $text=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p.FullName); $new=$text.Replace("S1626''s", "S1626's").Replace("S1906''s", "S1906's"); if ($new -ne $text) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p.FullName, $new, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))); Write-Host FIXED } else { Write-Host NOCHANGE }; Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 8 | Out-String -Width 250
